description_en: Queries the information about minor versions of AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-db-version-infos --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-mode StorageElastic --db-version '6.3.10.20。' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBVersionInfos

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type of the instance. Valid values:

StorageElastic: elastic storage mode.
Serverless: Serverless mode
parameters.help_zh:
实例资源类型，取值说明：

StorageElastic：存储弹性模式。
Serverless：Serverless模式
parameters.name: db_instance_mode

parameters.help_en: The minor version number that does not include the prefix
parameters.help_zh: 不带前缀的内核版本号
parameters.name: db_version
